samples: Anisong khao salak sabap phanya wok

lede: Wat Phothanaram accounts for 16 catalogued manuscripts, 1 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Chiang Rai (100% of the corpus for this temple). Nearly all (100%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. Dated witnesses run 1930–1976 CE (11 of 16 carry a date).
